title: What the filer gives instead
subtitle: For CVEs the NVD has not analyzed: the share with a filer CVSS, a CWE, affected versions or a CISA ADP value

plan.title: What the filer gives instead
plan.population: CVEs without NVD analysis, every window

plan.prediction: most carry a filer CVSS score; fewer carry affected versions
plan.interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

population: CVEs without NVD analysis, rejected CVEs excluded, every window
interval: cluster bootstrap by filer, 2000 resamples, 95 percent

prediction_check: A filer CVSS is on 0.8391823758785982 of them (most); affected versions on 0.9431612150113007 (not fewer).
method: A CVE is without NVD analysis when the change history shows no analysis event and its NVD status is not Analyzed or Modified. What the filer gave is read from the facts current at the cut: its own CVSS 3.0 or 3.1 vector, its CVSS 4.0 vector, a CWE id it named (not an NVD placeholder), affected versions in its record; CISA's from the ADP container and Vulnrichment. Intervals are a cluster bootstrap by filer, 2,000 resamples, 95 percent.
sql:
-- Q3: for CVEs the NVD has not analyzed, what the filer and CISA supplied, for the twenty filers
-- with the most such CVEs.
select
    filer,
    any_value(filer_type) as filer_type,
    count(*) as cves,
    avg(cast(has_filer_cvss3 as integer)) as filer_cvss3,
    avg(cast(has_filer_cvss40 as integer)) as filer_cvss40,
    avg(cast(has_filer_cwe as integer)) as filer_cwe,
    avg(cast(has_affected_versions as integer)) as affected_versions,
    avg(cast(has_adp_value as integer)) as cisa_adp_value
from gold.mart_backlog_q3
group by filer
order by cves desc, filer
limit 20
